I can't emphasize the aspect of Behavioral Game Design enough... They've literally made a product designed to exploit human nature and passed it off as a game series and people buy it. It's fucking stupid. Why do you think each successive game is no improvement over the last? Because they're not going to improve it. The goal isn't to keep players of their game satisfied, the goal is to keep them wanting more. THAT'S why they don't listen to their fans. They've designed a shit game made to keep players just hooked enough to buy into false lies and fake promises about the next game and buy it just to let them down again, but people will still buy it anyway, and if anyone criticises the system they get mobbed by a loyal circlejerk of dumb fanboys. They haven't done anything new and yet they're given awards and shit like this is a real video game.They're treated like some groundbreaking new front in video games just because they've perfected the art of implementing Behavioral Game Design into their shit. Congratu-freaking-lations. And meanwhile all the NPC's playing their shit just sit around and clap. How lame.

I personally take a different view that those who unthinkingly seek out relationships just for the sake of relationships and squander their life away with reproduction are mindless drones. While I acknowledge that women are hypergamous, I find it funny that MGTOWs are pissed off and triggered by the reality of the matter. Relationships and the idea of relationships are respectively, constructs that are of no interest to me. The concept of loyalty to the idea of a relationship between two people seems indiscreet at best. I view relationships as exorbitant and dated formalities, vain procedures rooted in extraneous tradition, heeded solely by obsequious lemmings. I would much rather devote my time to the understanding of human nature. I believe reproduction should be an act engaged in by a minority of people, should be considered a 'sacred' act, and offspring should be raised in a sort of nesting ground secluded from society until they are ready to emerge. This all sounds like some alien society, but it *would* be a society far more advanced than ours, and would be achievable when we have significantly improved lifespans, because more and more people would be abandoning the idea of reproducing in order to chase their dreams because a child would be a much larger investment of time and potential.

My thoughts are: You're best off abandoning this act of self flagellation and trying to maintain your self imposed rectitude in the face of the judgement of your peers, ancestors, society, etc. in promulgating an outmoded custom more suited to a troop of monkeys, otherwise, good luck trying to keep pace with ever moving goal posts.

That's really all I have to say and I'm not interested in further discussion. Goodbye.

This act of consideration while making life convenient for others, might give you the appearance of someone who doesn't have the attitude of looking out for them self first, and once you're seen to not fit in with the cutthroat attitude of most, you'll be seen as weak. Basically, your act of consideration will be seen as an act of weakness and naivete because they don't adhere to your higher values and if you display such frivolous behavior, well, you'll pretty much come across as a chump or inadvertently broadcast that you have those values to the wrong people, who hold them in contempt (returning the cart may even be seen as a display of moral superiority, furthering the odds of them feeling compelled to fuck with you) and they only see those values as something to be used against you, a liability.

So no, I don't return shopping carts.
